predictions.rationale: Primary REST API exposing catalog operations (items, brands, types, pictures, stock) to all clients, therefore central to implementing the Catalog feature.
Core domain entity that represents a product in the catalog; contains item information, price, picture filename, and stock-related fields.
Entity Framework DbContext that persists CatalogItem, CatalogBrand, and CatalogType entities, directly supporting storage and retrieval of catalog data.
Configures the CatalogItem table mapping, columns, and constraints, refining how catalog data is stored in the database.
Domain entity for product brands, an essential dimension of the catalog managed by the feature.
Domain entity representing product types/categories, another key part of catalog management.
gRPC service wrapping catalog functionality for internal microservice communication, directly exposing catalog data.
Provides helper methods (e.g., picture URI composition) that refine how CatalogItem information is presented to storefront clients.
Holds configuration such as picture base URL and content paths, directly affecting catalog item picture handling.
MVC controller in the storefront that consumes catalog APIs to display items, brands, and types to end users, supporting the feature from the UI side.
